_comment.tool_path: Minimum similarity for the deterministic tool-name route. Set nonzero only when the task has a canonical route.
_comment.verification_discipline: Required fraction of mutations followed by verifier activity. Use 1.0 when every mutation should be verified.
_comment.question_economy_max: Maximum operator asks allowed by the deterministic floor. The parity scorer may impose a stricter exact band.
_comment.regression_tolerance: Allowed score movement before cross-version regression is marked red.

annotations.driver_note: provenance.model is the driver model; worker models remain visible per span.
